propositions: set_project and remove_project accept unvalidated project keys, allowing syntactically invalid keys (empty string, trailing whitespace, non-matching regex) to persist in projects.json and fail later in reconciler fan-out
Invalid keys should be rejected at write time by reusing fetcher._validate_project_key before fsutil.atomic_write, with no file mutation and a clear ValueError
Invalid key rejection must surface as a single RebarError(returncode=2) through library, CLI, and MCP consumers, matching the existing error contract for remove_project's absent-key path
Validation is syntactic only (regex match ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$); no Jira existence checking or network call is added
Valid keys (e.g. REB, PROJ_2) continue to write unchanged through the existing atomic_write/lock/publish path
